description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithMembershipId', which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides a method to retrieve and format a membership name based on a given membership ID by utilizing the 'MembershipService'.

classes.name: FormatWithMembershipId
classes.description: A class that formats a membership ID into the corresponding membership name, using lazy initialization for the membership service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Takes an entity value (membership ID) and returns the membership name if found, otherwise null.

methods.name: getMembershipService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the 'MembershipService' instance used to fetch membership data.
